# Origional code and skeleton generated by grok.com

The repository has been translated into a modern C++17 project. Here's what was created:

## Structure

```
ramdisk-cpp/
├── CMakeLists.txt
├── README.md
├── include/ramdisk/
│   ├── RamDisk.hpp      # Public API (IRamDisk + factory)
│   ├── Logger.hpp
│   ├── Process.hpp
│   └── Utils.hpp
├── src/
│   ├── common/          # Factory, Process runner, Utils, Logger
│   ├── linux/           # tmpfs implementation
│   ├── macos/           # hdiutil + APFS implementation
│   └── windows/         # Arsenal Image Mounter (aim_ll) implementation
└── examples/
    ├── basic_example.cpp
    └── cli.cpp
```

## Key points of the port

| Aspect | Python original | C++ port |
|--------|-----------------|----------|
| Entry point | `RamDisk(size, mountpoint, logger)` | `ramdisk::createRamDisk(opts)` → `unique_ptr<IRamDisk>` |
| Platforms | macOS / Linux tmpfs / Windows AIM | Same backends |
| Lifetime | Manual `umount()` | RAII – destructor unmounts |
| Logging | Custom `CyLogger` | Lightweight thread-safe logger |
| Process exec | `RunWith` class | Cross-platform `runCommand` / `runShell` |
| Build | Python package | CMake (static or shared lib) |

## Build & try (already verified on this Linux host)

```bash
cd /home/workdir/artifacts/ramdisk-cpp
mkdir build && cd build
cmake .. -DRAMDISK_BUILD_EXAMPLES=ON
cmake --build .
# ./ramdisk_example          # needs root for tmpfs on Linux
# ./ramdisk_cli create --size 256
```

## Minimal usage

```cpp
#include "ramdisk/RamDisk.hpp"

auto disk = ramdisk::createRamDisk(512);   // 512 MB
if (disk->success()) {
    auto [ok, mnt, dev] = disk->getData();
    // use mnt …
    disk->umount();
}
```

The port keeps the same cross-platform philosophy and public interface
ideas while being idiomatic modern C++. The heavy Python helper subsystems
(full environment detection, composite menus, PySide UI, etc.) were
intentionally simplified; the core ramdisk create/mount/unmount
functionality is fully present for all three OSes.
